text: The Freedom Force is a 1978 animated television series produced by Filmation and aired on CBS as a segment of Tarzan and the Super 7. The series features a superhero team assembled from around the world by the heroine Isis to combat evil. Although Isis had previously appeared in the live-action series The Secrets of Isis, actress Joanna Cameron did not reprise her role in the animated version. Only five episodes were produced. In the series, Hercules frequently rides Pegasus, Merlin uses a flying carpet, and Sinbad's sidekick Lamprey provides comic relief. BCI Eclipse LLC, under its Ink & Paint classic animation entertainment brand and under license from Entertainment Rights, released all five episodes of The Freedom Force on DVD in Region 1 on August 22, 2006, along with all 13 episodes of Space Sentinels, presented uncut, digitally remastered for optimal audio and video quality, and in story continuity order. This earlier series shared several characters with The Freedom Force. The remastered edition includes scripts and Spanish language tracks for all five episodes, a gallery of original images, early presentation images, trivia, and interviews with creators Lou Scheimer, Buzz Dixon, Darrell McNeil, Michael Reaves, Robert Kline, and David Wise, as well as various special features related to Space Sentinels and Filmation. As of 2009, this DVD release has been discontinued and is out of print due to BCI Eclipse ceasing operations. Additionally, the episode "The Plant Soldiers" was included as a bonus feature on the DVD release of the live-action The Secrets of Isis series.
